posts.title: MNIST from Scratch
posts.content: Created a Model that predicts numbers, trained on MNIST dataset

posts.title: CLIP — Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training
posts.content: A technical deep-dive into how CLIP learns a shared embedding space for images and text using contrastive learning. Covers the ViT-B/32 image encoder, GPT-style text encoder, InfoNCE loss with full derivation, and why cosine similarity on a 512-dim unit sphere is the right geometry for semantic retrieval.

posts.title: Diffusion Models — DDPM, DDIM, and Score Matching
posts.content: A unified treatment of the three ideas behind modern image generation. Derives the DDPM forward/reverse process and simplified training objective from the ELBO, explains how DDIM reframes the same model as a deterministic probability flow ODE enabling step-skipping, and shows how score matching is the underlying theory connecting both — with the exact equation linking noise prediction to the score function.

posts.title: Synapse — Building a Local Multimodal Pipeline on a 4 GB GPU
posts.content: A builder's account of wiring a VLM, a contrastive retrieval model, and a single-step diffusion generator into one offline pipeline under a hard 4 GB VRAM budget. Covers staged model loading, the latent-space temperature implementation, the HF_HUB_OFFLINE import ordering footgun, HNSW retrieval design, and a full latency breakdown of every stage on an RTX 2050.
